name: opendisplay
description: Free, open-source Sidecar/Duet alternative — use your iPhone or iPad as a true second monitor for your Mac over USB or WiFi. Low latency H.264, Retina HiDPI, touch input.
one_liner: A free app that turns a spare iPhone or iPad into an extra screen for your Mac, over USB or WiFi, without paying a subscription like the paid alternatives require.
buyer: No strong paying buyer — it's a free, deliberately-not-monetized alternative aimed at people trying to avoid subscription fees for exactly this feature.
business_use_cases: A hardware accessory shop sells mounting stands and cables designed for using a phone/tablet as a second monitor alongside it.
A tech YouTuber builds content and affiliate revenue around 'best free second-monitor setup' tutorials featuring it.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a physical mounting-stand accessory bundle that rides on the app's popularity, via affiliate/direct sales.

steal_this: Not a real software business opportunity — its entire value proposition is being the free alternative to paid apps. The only adjacent business is selling the physical mount/cable accessories.
